 Frequently Asked Questions What is VPS Hosting? VPS  (Virtual Private Server) hosting is a type of web hosting that uses virtualization technology to provide you with private (dedicated) resources on a server with multiple users. 
 How does VPS Hosting differ from Shared Hosting? Unlike shared hosting, where multiple websites are hosted on a single server and share resources, VPS hosting offers dedicated resources and isolation, which results in better performance and security. 
 Is it possible to host multiple websites on a Verpex VPS server? Yes, depending on your VPS hosting plan, you can host multiple websites on a single server. 
 Are there any hidden costs with Verpex VPS hosting? No, we maintain transparency with our pricing. All costs are clearly outlined in our hosting plans, with no hidden fees. 
 Can I easily migrate my existing website to Verpex's VPS Hosting? Absolutely, we offer hassle-free migration services and our skilled team will ensure a smooth transition with minimal to no downtime. 
 What control panel options does Verpex offer for VPS hosting? cPanel/WHM is available as an option on every Verpex VPS plan, giving you a full interface for managing sites, accounts, and server settings. Every plan also includes full root access. 
 How much traffic can a Verpex VPS handle? Verpex VPS plans range from VPS-D4 (2 vCPUs, 4GB RAM, 80GB NVMe) up to VPS-D32 (16 vCPUs, 32GB RAM, 640GB NVMe). Every plan includes unlimited traffic, so there are no bandwidth caps as your site grows, and you can upgrade to a larger plan at any time. 
 When should I upgrade from shared hosting to a VPS? Move to a VPS when your site outgrows shared hosting resource limits, needs to handle traffic spikes, or requires root-level access to install and configure your own software. Verpex VPS plans start at 2 vCPUs, 4GB RAM, and 80GB NVMe storage, with a 99.9% uptime commitment. 
 What is the difference between VPS hosting and a dedicated server? A VPS gives you a guaranteed share of a physical server: your own vCPUs, RAM, and NVMe storage, plus full root access to configure it as you need. A dedicated server gives you the whole physical machine. Most sites that outgrow shared hosting need a VPS rather than a dedicated server. 
 Can I run WordPress on a Verpex VPS? Yes. Every Verpex VPS plan includes unlimited websites, one-click WordPress installs, and full root access, so you can run WordPress alongside anything else your site needs. Add cPanel/WHM if you want a managed interface, or configure the stack yourself. 
 Does Verpex offer cheap VPS hosting? Yes. VPS-D4 starts at $10/mo on the 12-month intro rate, then renews at $19.99/mo. It's cheap VPS hosting without cutting corners on resources. You get dedicated vCPUs, RAM, and NVMe storage at every tier, not shared or throttled ones. 
 What makes Verpex one of the best VPS hosting providers? Verpex is rated highly on Trustpilot with 1,400+ reviews and hosts over 300,000 websites. Every VPS plan includes dedicated resources, full root access, and 24/7 support, with no traffic caps to slow you down as you grow.

Once you bring us  5 paying customers,  your  commission rate will rise to 22%  for all new licenses. Up to 5 licenses: 20% commission. Over 5 licenses: 22% commission. If your customer pays on a monthly basis, you’ll earn your commission month by month. If a customer chooses annual billing, you’ll be paid annually.
